title: Mixed Event — Resonating with you — Episode7 A Gifted Opportunity

meta.Event Outline: Ichika and the others learn that Shiho has been scouted by another band. Shiho is finally able to express what she's been feeling, but how will her bandmates respond?

rows.Line: Show Venue - Backstage

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, what's this you have to say?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We took a long look at ourselves after we last talked and thought about what we want to do.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The three of us came up with an answer and we want you to know that we're serious about this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: S-Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I thought about it for a really long time and still felt that I want to be in a band with you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know that you'll start being even harder on us during practice and that we won't have time for much else.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And I'm still not sure if I can commit to trying to become a pro yet...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I want us to be in a band together!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I really love playing with you too, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Even though I was terrible at the drums in the beginning, you took the time to teach me during practice and I've become more confident in my abilities.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, you could've done that all on your own. All I did was go over the basics with you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That may be true, but that's not the only thing I learned from you, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: For the longest time, Shiho, all I could do was worry about my own well being and it bothered me so much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But you were the one that helped me overcome that and move forward...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I didn't do...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're wrong. I definitely wouldn't have been able to if it weren't for you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You taught me that kindness isn't just about pandering to someone's needs.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's why we all made the decision to come here and tell you exactly how we feel.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho, I'm sorry for not realizing this sooner.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Until now, I thought I was satisfied with just being in a band together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I thought that it would be nice to go pro and it felt like I was supporting your dream without understanding what I was actually doing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That mindset is what ended up hurting you the most. It kept holding you back...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But then I thought about it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: When I saw you performing with them the other day, I realized something...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I want to play music that can move people with you, Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: When I was doing street performances, I felt like I was reaching some of the people that stopped by to watch me play.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I thought that this is sort of what you meant by what you said then...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're nowhere near as good as STANDOUT right now, but someday, maybe we can reach that level, together...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm still not sure what it means to commit to trying to become a pro...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I know that I want to be in a band with you, Shiho. I want to perform in shows with you. I want our others to be moved by our music...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If that means aiming to become professionals, so be it...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thanks...
I understand now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't want you to bear that burden...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Burden? No, don't say that!
We just...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I'm so jealous...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: You're something else, Hinomori...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Getting others mixed up in your dreams.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Worrying about what'll happen to your friends or if it's even okay for you to put them through something like this...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: But I get where you're coming from.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho, I...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: How about I make a suggestion?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Play one song, right here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't understand.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Hinomori's got it in her head that it's not okay for her to force you into pursuing the same dream as her.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: She thinks it's unfair to do so and is worried about what'll happen.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: So it's your chance to tell her that you can handle it.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Tell her that you're absolutely ready to walk this path by playing her something.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Are you sure?
This is such an important day for your band...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: True. We can't really have you perform with us so...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: How does being our opening act sound?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Iori...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: But you won't have much time to get ready.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Yes or no.
I need to know right now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's so nice of them to lend us their instruments.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And they come pre-tuned.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They're gonna be used in a show, so they sort of need to be...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah.
But who would've thought that we'd be doing our first show as a band like this...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
This place is huge too!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It's like we're in a dream.
I can't believe this is happening...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So which song are we doing...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
What should we do?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
How about a Miku song?
Like the one we first played?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that one!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. We were all over the place back then, and Shiho was so mad that we fell apart just the way she said we would.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But she taught us so much after that, so we should be good now! I don't even need the sheet music for it anymore!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You sound so confident.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho, are you okay...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'm fine.
How about you, Ichika...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I'm a little nervous.
This being our first show and all...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But I'm excited too.
We finally get to do this together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You were so amazing that time you performed with STANDOUT.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm just happy that I get to be up here with you now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's give it everything we have, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right back at you...
